phrases.text: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, exalted is He: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ ("Has the tiding of the Overwhelming [al-ghāshiya] reached you?") (1)

phrases.text: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast
left to drink from a scalding spring
They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub
phrases.ar: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلا مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ
لا يُسْمِنُ وَلا يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ

phrases.text: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His saying, Exalted is He: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاعِمَةٌ (Faces on that Day will be joyful) (88:8).

phrases.text: where no idle talk will be heard
In it will be a running spring
Do they not ever reflect on camels
phrases.ar: أَفَلا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, exalted is He: أَفَلا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ ("Do they not then look at the camels, how they are created?") (17)

phrases.text: how they were firmly set up
for your duty is only to remind
You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺
But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief
then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment
Surely to Us is their return
then surely with Us is their reckoning
